title: Enablement Collateral: QuickRef Playbook, Persona Battlecards, and Live Demo Scripts for Optimize-2.3
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, role-targeted enablement kit for the Optimize-2.3 launch focused on: 1) 1-page QuickRef playbook for SDRs/AEs; 2) Persona battlecards (FinServ, Healthcare, Platform teams) that map value props to objections and ROI examples; 3) 2 live demo scripts with prompts, expected outputs, and fallback talking points; 4) CS Triage flows for common post-upgrade incidents (latency, quality regression). Coordinate timing and language with release notes owners and runtime team to ensure accuracy on performance claims.

acceptance_criteria: One-page QuickRef that fits on a single printable sheet and includes 5 battle-tested talk tracks
Three persona battlecards with at least one concrete ROI example and two objection-handling phrases each
Two demo scripts with step-by-step prompts, expected model outputs, timeout fallbacks, and a 5-minute TL;DR
CS triage flow with runbook steps, severity mapping, and escalation contacts, validated by support lead
All claims (latency, cost delta, quantization guidance) cross-checked with release notes and runtime bench results
Recorded demo videos (min 2) uploaded to drive with timestamps and short summaries
